name: Payment Icons
summary: Passive wrapping payment-method icon row with standard and established small icon presentation.

anatomy.name: imageIcon
anatomy.description: Raster or externally supplied payment-method mark.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Standard 24px icon height; the existing small modifier is exposed as a size capability rather than an interaction state.

states.name: iconHover
states.description: Existing pointer-only visual emphasis; it does not imply activation.

behavior.name: passiveMarks
behavior.description: Payment marks communicate accepted methods and do not become controls unless wrapped by a separately contracted link or button.

properties.name: icons
properties.description: Payment-method marks supplied by the target or payment provider.

properties.name: small
properties.description: Applies the established 18px icon-size modifier; this is a size capability, not a component state.

accessibility: Provide accessible names for payment methods when the marks are not accompanied by readable text.
Hide purely decorative duplicate marks from assistive technology.
Do not make passive payment marks keyboard-focusable solely because they have a hover treatment.
Do not imply that a payment method is available unless target checkout data supports the claim.

web.notes: Implemented in components/css/marketing.css. The registry-aligned size list remains default-only; small is explicitly classified as a size capability property.
